title: Print Hello, World!
instruction: Write code that prints **Hello, World!** exactly as shown.
test_suite:
import io, sys
import re

def t1():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output == "Hello, World!\n"

title: Print your favorite color
instruction: Print your favorite color from: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Purple, Orange, Pink, Black.
starter_code: # Pick a color from the list and print it
test_suite:
import io, sys
import re

def t1():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    allowed = ["Red","Blue","Green","Yellow","Purple","Orange","Pink","Black"]
    assert output.strip() in allowed
